verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              ततोऽहं तस्य वचनान्मार्कण्डेयं समाहितः। प्रश्नं तमेवान्वपृच्छं यन्मे पृष्ठः पुरा पिता॥१॥
स मामुवच धर्मात्मा मार्कण्डेयो महातपाः। भीष्म वक्ष्यामि कर्त्स्न्येन शृणुष्व प्रयतोऽनघ॥२॥
verses.bhavadeepa: उक्तं सप्तदशेऽध्याये पितृत्वं युक्तिसम्भवम्। आदिदेवसुतानां च तत्पुत्राणां परस्परम्॥१॥ ततोऽहं मे मया॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: अहं पितृप्रसादाद्वै दीर्घायुष्ट्वमवाप्तवान्। पितृभक्त्यैव लब्धं च प्राग्लोके परमं यशः॥३॥
verses.english: By the grace of my father I acquired longevity, and owing to my devoutness to my father I also acquired high renown in this mortal world...

verses.sanskrit: सोऽहं युगस्य पर्यन्ते बहुवर्षसहस्रिके। अधिरुह्य गिरिं मेरुं तपोऽतप्यं सुदुश्चरम्॥४॥
verses.english: Such as I am I undertook very difficult ascesis on Mt. meru for some thousands of years a the close of युग, era...

verses.sanskrit: ततः कदाचित्पश्यामि दिवं प्रज्वाल्य तेजसा। विमानं महदायान्तमुत्तरेण गिरेस्तदा॥५॥
verses.english: You are undertaking ascesis just to jhave a glimpse at me... here I present myeslf to you... now, tell me what I can do for you..." Thus सनत्कुमर said toi sage mArkanDeya.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्विमाने पर्यङ्के ज्वलितादित्यसन्निभम्। अपश्यं तत्र चैवाहं शयानं दीप्ततेजसम्॥६॥
verses.english: At certain certain time during that period I saw an aircraft coming from north brightening the sky with its resplendence...

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठमात्रं पुरुषमग्नावग्निमिवाहितम्। सोऽहं तस्मै नमस्कृत्य प्रणम्य शिरसा विभुम्॥७॥
verses.english: I still retain the aura of a neonate with which I took birth; hence I am called कुमर... a boy; सनत् - always; कुमर - a boy; a perpetual neonate; because neonates are doubtlessly away from lust, greed, conceit etc., so am I... so my name too came to pass as सनत्-कुमर...

verses.sanskrit: सन्निविष्टं विमानस्थं पाद्यार्घाभ्यामपूजयम्। अपृच्छं चैव दुर्धर्षं विद्याम त्वां कथं विभो॥८॥
verses.english: Then, on revering that emplaned being with folded-palms and bowing down and offering holy water, I asked, "you appear to be undeniable, aggregate of ascesis and prowess, possessing a triumphant air of nArAyaNa about you... to me you look like god of gods... but, how do I signify you...

verses.sanskrit: तपोवीर्यात्समुत्पन्नं नारायणगुणात्मकम्। दैवतं ह्यसि देवानमिति मे वर्तते मतिः॥९॥
verses.english: Then that highsouled-being spoke to me smilingly, "unconsummated is your ascesis wherefore you are unable to recognise me..." and then in a trice he transfigured into a most astonishing form... I have never seen such a personality in any man till then...

verses.sanskrit: स मामुवाच धर्मात्मा स्मयमान इवानघ। न ते तपः सुचरितं येन मां नावबुद्ध्यसे॥१०॥
verses.english: "Know me as the eldest brainchild of brahma... you are right in saying that I am an 'aggregate of ascesis and prowess, possessing an air of nArAyaNa about me' etc... I am that सनत्कुमार... you might have heard about me from the legendarily accounts of gods... blest you be... what can I do for you...
verses.bhavadeepa: हे नारायण गुणात्मकं मायामयशरीरं तपोवीर्यात् मत्तपःसामर्थ्यात्समुत्पन्नम् आविर्भूतमपि त्वाम् अहं तत्त्वतः कथं विद्याम् इति अहं तम् अपृच्छमिति योजना।  स्वमतमाह- दैवतं हीति॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: क्षणेनैव प्रमाणं स बिभ्रदन्यदनुत्तमम्। रूपेण न मया कश्चिद्दृष्टपूर्वः पुमान्क्वचित्॥११॥
verses.english: The other brainchildren of brahma younger to me are: क्रतु, वसिष्ठ, पुलह, पुलस्त्य, अत्रि, अङ्गिर, and मरिअचि. The lineages of these insuperable brainchildren of brahma are well established, and they who are reverential equally to gods and gandharva-s will hold the three worlds together, after receiving worship from those gods and gandharva-s...
verses.bhavadeepa: स्मयमानो गर्वित इव। ते त्वया तपः सुचरितं नेति मामाहेति शेषः॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit:
सनत्कुमार उवाच।
              विद्धि मां ब्रह्मणः पुत्रं मानसं पूर्वजं विभोः। तपोवीर्यसमुत्पन्नं नारायणगुणात्मकम्॥१२॥
verses.english: Amalgamating our souls in supreme soul, we the brainchildren of brahma discarded libidinal activity thus remained non-procreative...
verses.bhavadeepa: क्षणेनेति। पूर्वम् अङ्गुष्ठमात्रोऽपि क्षणात् महापुरुषलक्षणोऽभूदित्यर्थः॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार इति यः श्रुतो देवेषु वै पुरा। सोऽस्मि भार्गव भद्रं ते कं कामं करवाणि ते॥१३॥
verses.english: Amalgamating our souls in supreme soul, we the brainchildren of brahma discarded libidinal activity thus remained non-procreative...
verses.bhavadeepa: नारायणस्य गुणः शुद्धं सत्त्वं तदात्मकम्॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: ये त्वन्ये ब्रह्मणः पुत्राः यवीयांसस्तु ते मम। भ्रातरः सप्त दुर्धर्षास्तेषां वंशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः॥१४॥
verses.english: You are undertaking ascesis just to jhave a glimpse at me... here I present myeslf to you... now, tell me what I can do for you..." Thus सनत्कुमर said toi sage mArkanDeya.
verses.bhavadeepa: हे भार्गव भृगुवंशज॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: क्रतुर्वसिष्ठः पुलहः पुलस्त्योऽत्रिस्तथाङ्गिराः। मरीचिस्तु तथा धीमान्देवगन्धर्वसेविताः। त्रीँल्लोकान्धारयन्तीमान्देवगन्धर्वपूजिताः॥१५॥
verses.english: When that sempiternal god sanatkumara spoke to me in this way, then I asked that acquiescent god, of course, taking his permission to receive questions, about the genesis of manes, results of their beatification etc...
verses.bhavadeepa: यवीयांसः कनिष्ठाः॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: वयं तु यतिधर्माणः संयोज्यात्मानमात्मनि। प्रजा धर्मं च कामं च व्यपहाय महामुने॥१६॥
verses.english: Each to each is a father as well as a son in give and take relationship... thus the words देवताः and पितराः - gods and manes, can become nomenclative in their proper sense... therefore, you gods, you should be familiar with this interrelationship...

verses.sanskrit: यथोत्पन्नस्तथैवाहं कुमार इति विद्धि माम्। तस्मात्सनत्कुमारेति नामैतन्मे प्रतिष्ठितम्॥१७॥
verses.english: Originally brahma created gods saying to them, "you needs must adore me..." But, those gods left him off and started adoring themselves, as the beneficiaries of fruits of actions done by humans and other living beings... then brahma had to curse them saying, "you fools you shall now become scatterbrained loosing the faculty of retention..." Then they not only became blockheaded but also checked out of heaven because they are unable to recollect what heaven meant to them...
verses.bhavadeepa: वयं त्विति बहुवचनं सनकादीनन्तर्भाव्य॥१६॥

verses.sanskrit: मद्भक्त्या ते तपश्चीर्णं मम दर्शनकाङ्क्षया। एष दृष्टोऽस्मि भवता कं कामं करवाणि ते॥१८॥
verses.english: Later the gods reverently pleaded for the mercy of brahma, and brahma benevolently accorded it saying, "you gods, you will have to atone yourselves for your deviating behaviour... now go and seek your own sons, from whom you will receive proper enlightenment...
verses.bhavadeepa: सनत् निरन्तरं कुमार इव रागद्वेषादिशून्य इति सनत्कुमारपदस्य निर्वचनमाह- यथेति॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तवन्तं तमहं प्रत्यवोचं सनातनम्। अनुज्ञातो भगवता प्रीयमाणेन भारत॥१९॥
verses.english: Like distracted beings then the gods approached their own sons seeking information as to how to make amends. Their sons enlightened them about the propitiatory acts of atonement for the wrongdoings, done at three levels viz. mentally, vocally or physically, that mainly concerns about the filial duteousness... at the end, the sons of gods said to their fathers, "you have learned enough, म्य् देअर् सोन्स्, now you may return to brahma, the only knower of the subtext of atonement..."

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽहमेनमर्थं वै तमपृच्छं सनातनम्। पृष्टः पितॄणां सर्गं च फलं श्राद्धस्य चानघ॥२०॥
verses.english: Those gods are already carrying a curse of brahma on their head... now they felt ridiculed when their sons expressed a 'reverse filiation'... then the gods again approached brahma seeking clarification on this...

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेद संशयं भीष्म स तु देवेश्वरो मम। स मामुवाच धर्मात्मा कथान्ते बहुवार्षिके। रमे त्वयाऽहं विप्रर्षे शृणु सर्वं यथातथम्॥२१॥
verses.english: Dispelling all my doubts, oh, bhIShma... he told me at the end of his long-time narration, "oh, brahma-sage mArkanDeya, I am pleased with you... you may now listen to all in detail...

verses.sanskrit: देवानसृजत ब्रह्मा मां यक्ष्यन्तीति भार्गव। तमुत्सृज्य तथात्मानमयजंस्ते फलार्थिनः॥२२॥
verses.english: Each to each is a father as well as a son in give and take relationship... thus the words देवताः and पितराः - gods and manes, can become nomenclative in their proper sense... therefore, you gods, you should be familiar with this interrelationship...
verses.bhavadeepa: बहुवार्षिके कथान्ते चिरारब्धायाः कथाया अन्ते मामुवाच। रमे अहं त्वया तुष्यामि प्रश्नेन सन्तुष्टोऽस्मि॥२१॥

verses.sanskrit: ते शप्ता ब्रह्मणा मूढा नष्टसंज्ञा दिवौकसः। न स्म किञ्चिद्विजानन्ति ततो लोकोऽप्यमुह्यत॥२३॥
verses.english: Then the gods came back to their sons and said to them, "brahma dispelled all our doubts and we glad to know each other... oh, sons of gods, whatever you said is nothing but truth... you achieved fatherhood because you termed us as your sons... no doubt about it... oh, sons of gods, because you imparted knowledge to us you have become our fathers of gnosis - ज्ञन पित-स्... not only to us gods, but you should have fatherhood of all worlds... you are gods because you the sons of gods, and now on achieving fatherhood you shall be called पितॄ देवता-s... fatherly-gods... so-called manes... tell us what boon can be given to you... what for your heart is longing and..." Thus gods asked their sons. But when the sons of gods maintained a reticent silence, the gods continued to say:
verses.bhavadeepa: देवानिति। ते स्वपितरम् उत्सृज्य फलार्थिन इन्द्रियप्रीणनाख्यदृष्टफलार्थिनः॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: ते भूयः प्रणताः शप्ताः प्रायाचन्त पितामहम्। अनुग्रहाय लोकानां ततस्तानब्रवीदिदम्॥२४॥
verses.english: Those gods are already carrying a curse of brahma on their head... now they felt ridiculed when their sons expressed a 'reverse filiation'... then the gods again approached brahma seeking clarification on this...
verses.bhavadeepa: ततो लोकोऽपि तदनुसारी अमुह्यत॥२३॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तं चरध्वं वै व्यभिचारो हि वः कृतः। पुत्रांश्च परिपृच्छध्वं ततो ज्ञानमवाप्स्यथ॥२५॥
verses.english: And when, oh, sons of gods, who now stand consecrated as पितृ-गणा-s, observances of fatherly gods, so-called manes, you will be sated with the beatification processes offered to you, you in turn will always be satiating सोम, the god of moon and the repository of nectar, and when सोम is sated through you, he will be sating whole world spanning from mountains to oceans, whether animate or inanimate... this shall be the cyclic process in give-and-take syndrome...

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तक्रियार्थं ते पुत्रान्पप्रच्छुरार्तवत्। तेभ्यस्ते प्रयतात्मानः शशंसुस्तनयास्तदा॥२६॥
verses.english: Thus this beatification is welfare-enriching process to those humans who undertake it, and you as fatherly-gods shall always be according well-being, progeny etc to them...
verses.bhavadeepa: व्यभिचारः पूज्यपूजातिक्रमः आत्मपूजा च वः युष्माभिः यथैतैरहमवज्ञात एवम् एतत्पुत्रा अप्येतानशिष्यत्वेनावजानन्त्वित्याशयेनाह- पुत्रानिति॥२५॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तानि धर्मज्ञा वाङ्मनःकर्मजानि वै। शंसन्ति कुशला नित्यं चक्षुर्भ्यामपि नित्यशः॥२७॥
verses.english: Thus this beatification is welfare-enriching process to those humans who undertake it, and you as fatherly-gods shall always be according well-being, progeny etc to them...
verses.bhavadeepa: आर्तवत् नीचत्वापादनात् पीडिता इव। प्रयतात्मानः निगृहीतचित्ताः। ध्यानेनालोच्य प्रायश्चित्तानि शशंसुरित्यर्थः॥२६॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तार्थतत्त्वज्ञा लब्धसंज्ञा दिवौकसः। गम्यन्तां पुत्रकाश्चेति पुत्रैरुक्ताश्च ते तदा॥२८॥
verses.english: This is how the supreme brahma educated us... as such, oh, sons of gods, his word shall come true... henceforth let us mutually become fathers and/or sons according as the situation..." This is how gods who realised their mistake have said to their sons.
verses.bhavadeepa: तानि च वाङ्मनःकर्मजानि स्तोत्रेण भक्तिश्रद्धापुरस्कृतेन ध्यानेन नमस्कारादिक्रियया च जातानीत्यर्थः॥२७॥

verses.sanskrit: अभिशप्तास्तु ते देवाः पुत्रवाक्येन निन्दिताः। पितामहमुपागच्छन्संशयच्छेदनाय वै॥२९॥
verses.english: "Thus the gods are both fathers and gods; fatherly gods are both fathers and gods; they mutually conduct themselves in पिता-पुत्र-न्याय - an indivisible syndrome of father-son-father-son, ad infinitum..."Thus sanat-kumAra enlightened sage mArkanDeya about the genesis of fatherly-gods, so-called manes, and about the fruits of their beatification.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्राय इति। भोः पुत्रकाः यूयं लब्धसंज्ञाः प्राप्तज्ञानाः भवत इति शेषः। कुतः लब्धसंज्ञाः यतः प्रायश्चित्तस्य अर्थतत्त्वं प्रयोजनयाथात्म्यं तदभिज्ञाः। तच्च येभ्यो जन्म विद्या च लभ्येत ते वाङ्मनःकर्मभिर्यष्टव्या इति॥२८॥

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तानब्रवीद्देवो यूयं वै ब्रह्मवादिनः। तस्माद्यदुक्तं युष्माकं तत्तथा न तदन्यथा॥३०॥
verses.bhavadeepa: गम्यतामित्युक्तास्ते पितामहमुपागच्छन्निति सम्बन्धः। अभिशप्ताः पुत्रका इति वदद्भिः पुत्रैः पराभूताः संशयस्तु कथमस्मत्पुत्राः सन्तोऽस्मान् पुत्रा इति सम्बोधयन्तीति एतद्युक्तमयुक्तं वेत्येवंरूपस्तस्य छेदनाय॥२९॥

verses.sanskrit: यूयं शरीरकर्तारस्तेषां देवा भविष्यथ। ते तु ज्ञानप्रदातारः पितरो वो न संशयः॥३१॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the seventeenth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the genesis of fatherly-gods, so-called manes, and about the fruits of their beatification.
verses.bhavadeepa: ब्रह्मवादिनः यस्तानि विजानात्स पितुः पिता सदिति मन्त्रार्थज्ञाः भवन्तः अतो यत्तैरुक्तं तत्तथैव न तत्र संशयः कार्यः। यः पुमान् तानि श्रुतिगुह्यानि विजानात् विजानीयात् स पितुः पिता सन् दीप्यत इति मन्त्रपदानामर्थः॥३०॥

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यं पितरो यूयं ते चैवेति न संशयः। देवाश्च पितरश्चैव तद्बुध्यध्वं दिवौकसः॥३२॥
verses.english: "Thus the gods are both fathers and gods; fatherly gods are both fathers and gods; they mutually conduct themselves in पिता-पुत्र-न्याय - an indivisible syndrome of father-son-father-son, ad infinitum..."Thus sanat-kumAra enlightened sage mArkanDeya about the genesis of fatherly-gods, so-called manes, and about the fruits of their beatification.
verses.bhavadeepa: यूयमिति। श्लोकत्रयेण देवाः पितरः पितरो देवाः इति मन्त्रपादार्थमुपबृंहयति॥३१॥

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते पुनरागम्य पुत्रानूचुर्दिवौकसः। ब्रह्मणा च्छिन्नसन्देहाः प्रीतिमन्तः परस्परम्॥३३॥
यूयं वै पितरोऽस्माकं यैर्वयं प्रतिबोधिताः। धर्मज्ञाः कश्च वः कामः को वरो वः प्रदीयताम्॥३४॥
यदुक्तं चैव युष्माभिस्तत्तथा न तदन्यथा। उक्ताश्च यस्माद्युष्माभिः पुत्रका इति वै वयम्। तस्माद्भवन्तः पितरो भविष्यन्ति न संशयः॥३५॥
योऽनिष्ट्वा तु पितॄञ्छ्राद्धैः क्रियाः काश्चित्करिष्यति। राक्षसा दानवा नागाः फलं प्राप्स्यन्ति तस्य तत्॥३६॥
verses.english: Whoso worships gods and gods alone, duly bypassing the acts of beatifying fatherly-gods viz. the श्राद्ध-क्रिया-s to pitR^i devatA-s, so-called manes; the fruits of his worship are henceforth transferable to राक्षसा-स्, दानवा-स् and नागा-स्...

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धैराप्यायिताश्चैव पितरः सोममव्ययम्। आप्याय्यमाना युष्माभिर्वर्धयिष्यति नित्यदा॥३७॥
श्राद्धैराप्यायितः सोमो लोकानाप्याययिष्यति। समुद्रपर्वतवनं जङ्गमाजङ्गमैर्वृतम्॥३८॥
verses.bhavadeepa: श्राद्धैरिति। पितरो लौकिकाः। युष्माभिर्दिव्यैः पितृभिराप्याय्यमानाः स्वयं च आप्यायिताः सन्तः स्वाधिदेवताः सोमं वर्द्धयन्ति तर्पयन्ति। छान्दोग्ये तद्यद्भक्तं प्रथममागच्छेत्तद्धोमीयमिति प्राणाग्निहोत्रे आध्यात्मिकदेवतातृप्त्या आधिदैविकदेवतातृप्तेर्दर्शनात्॥३७॥

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धानि पुष्टिकामाश्च ये करिष्यन्ति मानवाः। तेभ्यः पुष्टिं प्रजाश्चैव दास्यन्ति पितरः सदा॥३९॥
श्राद्धे ये च प्रदास्यन्ति त्रीन्पिण्डान्नामगोत्रतः। सर्वत्र वर्तमानांस्तान्पितरः सपितामहान्। भावयिष्यन्ति सततं श्राद्धदानेन तर्पिताः॥४०॥
एवमाज्ञापितं पूर्वं ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना। इति तद्वचनं सत्यं भवत्वद्य दिवौकसः। पुत्राश्च पितरश्चैव वयं सर्वे परस्परम्॥४१॥
verses.english: This is how the supreme brahma educated us... as such, oh, sons of gods, his word shall come true... henceforth let us mutually become fathers and/or sons according as the situation..." This is how gods who realised their mistake have said to their sons.
verses.bhavadeepa: भावयिष्यन्ति वर्द्धयिष्यन्ति॥४०॥

verses.sanskrit:
सनत्कुमार उवाच।
              त एते पितरो देवा देवाश्च पितरस्तथा। अन्योन्यं पितरो ह्येते देवाश्च पिरतश्च ह॥४२॥
